character.description: The same young adult woman anime protagonist in every shot: dark auburn hair in a high braided ponytail, bright sea-green eyes, with a recognizable consistent face and adult body proportions. They are a daring navigator charting hidden currents and forgotten pirate routes. Fixed costume: a weathered navy captain's coat over a white shirt, red sash, fitted trousers, and deck boots. Signature tool or keepsake: a brass dividers compass attached to a salt-stained map case. Maintain the exact same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, proportions, costume silhouette, and signature object across the complete music video.
consistency_rules: One clearly defined protagonist leads this theme from beginning to end.
Keep the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, adult age impression, and body proportions in every scene.
Preserve the signature outfit, its color identity, and the defining tool or keepsake.
Do not redesign, replace, or multiply the lead character unless the lyrics explicitly require another person.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in galleon on open water, sandy island cove with chests, storm-tossed sea; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with ocean teal, parchment tan, timber brown, treasure gold; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by low deck-level shot of billowing sails, wide aerial view of a galleon at sea, close-up of a compass and worn map; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
